description: This file defines an interface `TopicPathBuilder` which provides method signatures for building `TopicPath` instances. It includes methods to set various properties such as group, criterion, channel, and specific specialized builders for search, commands, events, errors, messages, and acknowledgements, indicating it is part of a fluent builder pattern for constructing topic paths in a messaging or pub/sub system.

classes.name: TopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface to facilitate the construction of `TopicPath` objects through method chaining, with methods to set different components like group, criterion, channel, and more specialized sub-builders.

methods.name: things
methods.description: Sets the group of the topic path to 'THINGS' and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: policies
methods.description: Sets the group of the topic path to 'POLICIES' and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'SEARCH' and returns a SearchTopicPathBuilder for further configuration.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'COMMANDS' and returns a CommandsTopicPathBuilder for further configuration.

methods.name: twin
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to 'TWIN' and returns the builder.

methods.name: live
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to 'LIVE' and returns the builder.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to 'NONE' and returns the builder.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'EVENTS' and returns an EventsTopicPathBuilder for further configuration.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'ERRORS' and returns a TopicPathBuildable for further configuration.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'MESSAGES' and returns a MessagesTopicPathBuilder for further configuration.

methods.name: acks
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to 'ACKS' and returns an AcknowledgementTopicPathBuilder for further configuration.
